$comment: The cases every implementation of assistant.schema.json 0.1 agrees on. Each valid document validates. Each invalid one is a valid document with exactly one change, an RFC 6902 add, replace or remove, so it fails for that change and nothing else. Bailey runs this table against the schema with jsonschema; a repository that vendors the schema runs the same table with its own validator, so the two cannot quietly disagree about what the format allows. schemas/README.md describes the table.
